listingTitle: Avoid repeated C# list membership scans
title: Avoid repeated C# list membership scans
why: List Contains scans linearly, so calling it inside another loop can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Build a HashSet before the loop when repeated membership checks dominate and list ordering is not needed for lookup.
limitations: Only variables whose nearest declaration before the loop is List, IList, IReadOnlyList, or ArrayList and that use Contains in a multiline loop are reported.
Nested generic declarations, collection size, aliases, and intentionally small lists are not inferred.
